Tree comments:
Measured by T. Sharp 11/1/2019.Tree located in small park across from the Cathedral of.Lady of our Assumption in Oaxaca city. Tree planted ca. 1870.
Tree is locally known as Indian Laurel and is commonly known or misidentified as F. retusa, F. fintida, and F, benjamina.
